children: Krishnankutty expands his mandate from Asia Pacific and Japan to oversee talent acquisition across Asia, Middle East and Africa

Siemens Healthineers has elevated Ajay Krishnankutty to Head of Talent Acquisition, AMEA (Asia, Middle East and Africa), expanding his remit across a broader group of markets. He was previously responsible for talent acquisition across the Asia Pacific and Japan (APJ) region.

Krishnankutty joined Siemens Healthineers in 2022 and has held successive talent acquisition leadership roles, including Head of Talent Acquisition for Zone India before taking charge of the APJ region. His latest elevation marks a further expansion of his regional responsibilities.

Before joining Siemens Healthineers, he was Head of Recruitment at Legato Health Technologies and Global Head of Recruitment at IG. Earlier in his career, he held HR leadership responsibilities at Concentrix, spanning HR information systems, HR analytics and special projects.

His professional experience also includes talent acquisition, talent management and operations roles at ISGN and UST Global, along with sourcing and planning experience with Information Dynamics in the United Arab Emirates.

Krishnankutty brings more than two decades of experience across talent acquisition and talent management. His expanded role comes as Siemens Healthineers continues to build talent capabilities across its geographically diverse operations.
He holds a Master of Business Administration in Marketing and Finance from the Institute of Management in Kerala.
